positions.stance: Will "audit every agency, expose the fraud, and prosecute the corrupt."
Will cut regulations on Texas's energy sector to lower energy costs for families.
Will defend parental rights, school choice, and "faith, family, and freedom."
As a trafficking survivor, pledges to fight to end human trafficking; says the SAFE NIGHTS Act will be her first bill.
Calls to expose congressional misconduct, "Release the Epstein files," and "End the two-tiered justice system."

H6TX02244.name: Jon Bonck
H6TX02244.bio: Mortgage professional from Greater Houston with two decades in real estate, and a deacon at Second Baptist Church.

positions.stance: "Finish the wall. End the invasion. Put Texas first."
"Life begins at conception. No compromise."
"No woke curriculum. No gender ideology. Parents first."
Supports protecting the Second Amendment: "God-given rights don't need D.C.'s permission."
"Faith belongs in public life—not under attack."

H4TX38011.name: Melissa McDonough
H4TX38011.bio: Realtor and real estate brokerage owner/manager with a background in small business management, and a Harris County election worker.

positions.stance: Hopes to continue "smart policy that is proactive and not reactive" on inflation.
Says "good trade policy requires treating your trading partners with respect" and criticizes trade-war tariffs.
Calls for proper funding of public education instead of banning books and classes that teach about culture.
Says college should be an option for all, and "we need to make quality education more affordable and accessible."
Supports easier mail-in voting, county-wide voting, more accessible polling locations, and safe, well-stocked polling places.

H6FL01390.name: Jimmy Patronis
H6FL01390.bio: U.S. Representative for Florida's 1st District; former Florida Chief Financial Officer and State Fire Marshal, state representative, and family restaurant manager.

positions.stance: Lists his priorities as supporting President Trump's America First agenda "through cutting taxes, reining in spending, investing in the military and reforming veteran's services."
Will push for homeowner relief, including federal legislation to cut insurance rates by at least 25%.
Will "fight to stop the price gouging that is hurting drivers" on car insurance.
Will hold corporations accountable for "shrinkflation" and restore fairness to the market.
Supports the bipartisan ROAD to Housing Act and stopping large Wall Street investors from buying up homes.
Will "fight for universal, affordable, quality healthcare" so everyone can see a doctor without going broke.

H6FL02299.name: Amanda Green
H6FL02299.bio: Operations director and pricing expert who worked for a major implementing partner of USAID.

positions.stance: Will fight corporate price-gouging and "illegal tariff taxes," expand affordable housing and healthcare, and invest in cheaper energy.
Will seek a House Agriculture Committee seat, champion a strong Farm Bill, and fully fund nutrition programs.
Supports affordable basic care for all Americans, strengthening Medicare and Medicaid, and reversing cuts to rural healthcare.
Supports banning congressional stock ownership and trading, term limits, removing dark money, and restoring federal voting-rights protections.
Would remove the Social Security contribution cap, expand Medicare, and defend veterans' earned benefits.

H6FL02331.name: Austin Rogers
H6FL02331.bio: Attorney and former General Counsel to U.S. Senator Rick Scott.

positions.stance: Will "fiercely defend the First Amendment" and every American's right to practice their faith freely.
Supports parental rights and opposes policies that undermine families; believes "biological men have no business participating in women's sports."
Supports President Trump's trade approach and policies to keep everyday essentials affordable: "Make America Affordable Again!"
Says he is "100% pro life from conception" and will support pro-life policies.
Will fight for military funding and equipment and for veterans' access to high-quality VA care.

H0FL03175.name: Kat Cammack
H0FL03175.bio: U.S. Representative serving her third term for Florida's 3rd District.

positions.stance: Says she is "adamant about securing the southern border."
Will "always advocate for our small businesses."
Says she "has never wavered in her support for the Second Amendment."
Believes "taxes should be low and that we must keep government spending minimal and efficient."
Supports "our nation's duty to stand up for our veterans and first responders."

H6FL03099.name: Seth Harp
H6FL03099.bio: Seventh-grade civics teacher in Gainesville and former radio station manager and University of Florida adjunct professor.

positions.stance: Would raise the payroll tax cap to $250,000 to secure benefits without reducing payments for retirees.
Would "guarantee affordable health care for every American" so no family goes bankrupt from illness.
Proposes the C.U.B.S. Act, a sliding-scale subsidy to expand affordable child care for working families.
Proposes the H.E.A.R.T. Act to tax large corporate home purchases and give builders incentives for affordable first-time homes.
Proposes the D.O. Initiative to double the behavioral health workforce over a decade; "Mental health is health care."

H2FL04211.name: Aaron Bean
H2FL04211.bio: U.S. Representative for Florida's 4th District; former Florida Senate President Pro Tempore, state representative, Fernandina Beach mayor, and small-business owner.

positions.stance: Will cut red tape and keep taxes low so Northeast Florida stays a top place to work and hire.
Supports "putting parents, not Washington bureaucrats, in charge of the classroom."
Fighting for the port, rail, and roads that make Jacksonville a logistics hub.
Backs "the bases, the benefits, and the families who serve."
Supports "finishing the wall, backing the Border Patrol, and ending catch-and-release."

H6FL05193.name: LaShonda Holloway
H6FL05193.bio: Attorney (University of Florida law degree) whose federal service career began at the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency.

positions.stance: Supports lower premiums and drug costs, expanded Medicare, and "guaranteeing every American access to quality care as a basic right."
Would "cut red tape, expand access to capital, and protect Main Street entrepreneurs from unfair corporate competition."
Supports investing in American clean energy and domestic supply chains to stabilize energy prices.
Supports "fully funding VA healthcare," expanding mental health and housing services, and timely delivery of earned benefits.
Says "no one is above the law" and officials should answer to the people, not special interests.

H6FL04105.name: John Rutherford
H6FL04105.bio: U.S. Representative for Florida's 5th District and former Jacksonville Sheriff.

positions.stance: Fighting inflation "by blocking new taxes and slashing existing taxes" and removing red tape to reduce costs.
Supports increased troop pay and resources, VA reform and accountability, and mental health and PTSD funding for veterans.
Supported President Trump's tax cuts for families and small businesses and federal funding for regional transportation projects.
Authored the STOP School Violence Act and voted to fund the border wall and enforce immigration laws.
Worked to protect Florida's beaches and waterways from offshore drilling and sought hurricane rebuilding funds.

H6FL05250.name: Rachel Grage
H6FL05250.bio: Former biomedical engineer and elected homeowners association president.

positions.stance: Would keep healthcare premiums and prescription costs affordable, maintain federal cost-sharing supports, and stabilize home insurance.
Would "safeguard earned benefits and ensure long-term solvency for seniors and future generations."
Supports campaign finance transparency, reducing big money in politics, and holding officials to the same standards as citizens.
Supports secure borders through "smart, efficient enforcement" alongside "a fair and humane immigration system that respects due process."
Would protect personal privacy and access to healthcare and ensure equality under the law for all Americans.

H6FL06258.name: Randy Fine
H6FL06258.bio: Businessman who built and ran three companies and served in the Florida House of Representatives.

positions.stance: "LOWER insurance rates and hold insurance companies accountable."
"PROTECT Social Security and Medicare."
"ENSURE honesty and transparency in government."
"SECURE our borders."
"BOOST job creation and the economy."
Supports expanding affordable housing, stabilizing insurance through federal reinsurance, fighting price gouging, and banning congressional stock trading.
Supports small-business growth, apprenticeships and reskilling programs, and coordinated support to address homelessness.
Would "protect organizing rights and strengthen unions" and create safeguards so AI and automation strengthen workers.
Would "ask the wealthiest Americans to contribute a fairer share" and negotiate prescription prices.
Would "protect reproductive freedom and personal medical privacy" and defend freedom of and from religion.

H6FL07215.name: Bale Dalton
H6FL07215.bio: Retired U.S. Navy captain and helicopter pilot and former NASA Chief of Staff.

positions.stance: Would reverse health premium hikes and tariffs, crack down on power companies and insurers, and supports raising the minimum wage and the PRO Act.
Supports restoring Medicaid funding, drug price negotiation, protecting Social Security and Medicare, and codifying Roe into federal law.
Calls for "immediate tax relief for Florida families and tackling wasteful spending."
Supports barring officials from betting on prediction markets and making it illegal for politicians to trade stocks in companies they regulate.
Supports enabling more housing at all income levels and would "ban Wall Street speculators from buying up single-family homes."

H6FL07231.name: Ryan Elijah
H6FL07231.bio: Emmy-winning former Central Florida television news anchor.

positions.stance: Supports keeping taxes low, achieving American energy independence, curbing government spending, and reducing federal regulations.
Supports patient-centered options, expanded Health Savings Accounts, and clear pricing requirements for hospitals and insurers.
Will "support strong consumer-protection legislation" and pursue those who prey on Floridians, especially seniors.
Will prioritize working with federal agencies on long-term beach nourishment and storm-damage reduction projects.
"Champions parental rights and school choice" and supports protecting local control of schools.

H4FL08168.name: Mike Haridopolos
H4FL08168.bio: U.S. Representative for Florida's 8th District; educator, author, and former Florida Senate President.

positions.stance: "Politicians should not profit from the very laws they pass"; supported legislation to ban members of Congress from trading stocks.
Supports the SAVE America Act and voter verification measures; "American elections should be decided by American citizens."
Supports tax relief, more opportunities for small businesses, and reducing burdensome federal and state regulations.
Supports "common sense ideas that protect our Lagoon"; co-chairs the bipartisan Congressional Estuary Caucus.
Says space exploration creates high-paying District 8 jobs and is "key to American technological innovation as well as our national security."

H6FL06399.name: Jennifer Jenkins
H6FL06399.bio: Educator and former Brevard County School Board member.

positions.stance: Would stabilize Florida's property insurance market through federal reinsurance and oppose "reckless tariffs" that raise prices.
Would expand Medicaid, restore and strengthen ACA subsidies, and protect coverage for pre-existing conditions.
Supports stable funding for first responders and evidence-based strategies to reduce violence and recidivism.
Would protect the U.S. Department of Education, fully fund IDEA, defend Section 504, and expand Title I.

H6FL09179.name: Darren Soto
H6FL09179.bio: U.S. Representative for Florida's 9th District since 2017; lawyer and former Florida state representative and senator.

positions.stance: Opposes increased tariffs and other policies raising grocery, gasoline, and healthcare costs; seeks more high-paying regional jobs.
Fighting cuts to Medicare, Medicaid, and the ACA and will work to "reverse these cuts."
Supports legislation to stop stock trading by members of Congress and the administration.
Supports the Social Security 2100 Act to scrap the income cap and fund Social Security to 2100.
Supports bipartisan comprehensive immigration reform, including border security and a pathway for Dreamers, TPS recipients, and farmworkers.

H6FL09294.name: Dan Green
H6FL09294.bio: U.S. Navy Reserve commander who served four tours in the Middle East and Central Asia and a civilian tour in Afghanistan with the State Department.

positions.stance: Will work to "safeguard our Constitutional rights on day one."
Will work with President Trump "to ensure our military remains funded and fit for action."
Seeks "real solutions to overdevelopment in Florida to protect our way of life."
Stands with homeowners facing rising insurance rates and will "take their fight to Washington."
Will work with President Trump to lower fuel and grocery costs and the overall cost of living.

H2FL10259.name: Maxwell Frost
H2FL10259.bio: Organizer and the first Generation Z member of Congress; former National Organizing Director of March for Our Lives and ACLU national organizer.

positions.stance: Will fight "to end gun violence."
Will fight to "win Medicare For All."
Will fight to "transform our racist criminal justice system."
Will fight to "end the climate crisis."

H6FL11357.name: James Pericola
H6FL11357.bio: Attorney, former Clinton administration presidential appointee, former congressional staff member, and government affairs executive.

positions.stance: Opposes cuts or privatization of Social Security and Medicare and supports Medicare negotiating lower drug prices.
Would expand access to affordable, high-quality healthcare "by protecting the Affordable Care Act."
Would secure federal funding to combat the housing crisis and lower property insurance costs.
Would work to eliminate income taxes for those earning under $100,000 and cut taxes for middle-class families.
Will fight to end gerrymandering and pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Act.

H6FL11332.name: Joe Strada
H6FL11332.bio: Businessman who started in the skilled trades and grew a family-owned Central Florida company.

positions.stance: Supports "serious investigations into potential congressional insider trading" and accountability for officials who profit from office.
Supports "firm congressional term limits."
Supports "a balanced budget amendment requiring Washington to live within its means."
"Finish the wall, restore order, stop illegal crossings, and put American citizens first."
Would treat cartel violence, human trafficking, and fentanyl as national security threats.

H6FL09070.name: Gus Bilirakis
H6FL09070.bio: U.S. Representative and senior member of the House Energy and Commerce Committee; attorney.

positions.stance: Pushes affordability measures including no tax on tips and overtime, ending taxes on Social Security, and lower prescription costs for seniors.
Filed the Homeowners Premium Tax Reduction Act, a $10,000 above-the-line deduction on homeowners insurance premiums.
Secured $585 million in federal disaster-recovery funding for Pasco County after Helene and Milton.
Secured funding to expand mental-health services and extended telehealth for seniors through the EASE Act.
Leading efforts to expand the federal newborn-screening panel and reauthorize the Pediatric Cancer Voucher.

H6FL15200.name: Kimberly Overman
H6FL15200.bio: Small business owner and former Hillsborough County Commissioner.

positions.stance: Will fight for investment in affordable housing and transportation; says housing, transit, and child care are "essential infrastructure."
Will work to lower prescription drug costs, expand coverage including mental health care, and protect access to reproductive services.
Supports "strong law enforcement paired with investments in mental health services, youth engagement, and community-led crime prevention."
Will advocate for school investment, competitive teacher pay, and expanded early childhood, vocational, and higher education.
Will fight to improve access to VA care, mental health services, job training, and transitional support for veterans.

H0FL13158.name: Anna Paulina Luna
H0FL13158.bio: U.S. Representative and U.S. Air Force veteran.

positions.stance: Co-sponsored legislation to expand care for veterans seeking mental health or substance abuse treatment.
Co-sponsored a bill to prohibit China, Russia, Iran, and North Korea from buying U.S. agricultural land or companies.
Co-sponsored legislation to cap student loan interest rates at 3%.
Co-sponsored legislation to designate and treat drug cartels as Foreign Terrorist Organizations.
Says she pressured the Army Corps of Engineers to start Pinellas beach renourishment projects.

H6FL13312.name: Leela Gray
H6FL13312.bio: Former U.S. Army and Army Reserve officer and business leader.

positions.stance: Would pass the Major Richard Star Act and restore VA health and benefits funding cut by DOGE.
Calls the war in Iran "reckless" and says "I will fight to end the war."
Will fight for a constitutional amendment to reverse Citizens United and refuses corporate PAC money.
Would "end illegal tariffs, and cut red tape and regulatory burdens" for local small businesses.
"We must protect and strengthen Social Security and Medicare to ensure every senior can age with dignity."

H6FL11126.name: Kathy Castor
H6FL11126.bio: U.S. Representative and senior member of the House Energy and Commerce Committee; former Hillsborough County Commissioner and attorney.

positions.stance: Will fight "for a diverse and strong Tampa Bay economy that keeps costs for families in check, keeps health care and energy affordable."

H6FL14237.name: Mike Beltran
H6FL14237.bio: Attorney and former six-year member of the Florida House of Representatives.

positions.stance: Will bring his fight against healthcare bureaucracies blocking new clinics, and for telehealth access, to Congress.
Will "cut the wasteful spending that drives prices up and keep your money in your pocket."
Will fight to reduce regulations that raise costs and limit opportunity for families and businesses.
Will fight to ensure no data center is built locally "without local approval and a guarantee it won't raise your energy bills."
Supports banning members of Congress from trading individual stocks and strengthening transparency rules.
